text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —I see~ So even Flight-senpai hasn't seen Machan around.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I haven't run into her on campus today yet.
Is it urgent business?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! We just wanted to invite her to hit up a cafe after school, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If you happen to see her, could you let her know we'll be waiting in the classroom? We'd really appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A place where Machan might be...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...It's got to be over there, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I knew she'd be on the rooftop♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Flight-san? Were you searching for Machan?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Vodka-chan and the others said they're waiting in the classroom for you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Were you... looking at the sky, Machan?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at that cloud! It's shining in rainbow colors!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is called an iridescent cloud, apparently one of the ways clouds can appear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: They say good fortune visits whoever manages to spot one.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it feels like happiness is coming our way. Because it's just so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even with a cloud possessing such wonderful colors, if no one looks up at the sky—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It may simply vanish without ever being found by anyone.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: In that case, let's preserve it! As a memory for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A memory?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That's right! If both of us gaze upon this beautiful scenery together, we can talk about how wonderful it was later on, can't we?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That way, it'll last forever and ever... and never vanish.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: There! Now that cloud has properly been discovered by us!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It won't have to vanish without being found anymore!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Machan has just realized something extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Flight-san adds brilliance and color not only to fashion, but even to the color of the sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps what was truly discovered... was Machan's cherished feelings.
On the way to the Trainer's office, I spotted four familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So, what were you actually doing, Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was admiring a rainbow cloud.
It was extraordinarily vivid and colorful!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds pretty awesome, huh?
Hmm... Did it already drift off somewhere?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I captured it perfectly.
Here, take a look!
